description: A second timezone clock beside GNOME's built-in date and time (updates once a minute, no seconds), styled as a panel pill with a dark card menu. Includes weather (Open-Meteo), a Pomodoro timer and a Caffeine keep-awake toggle, with tabbed settings (Clock, Weather, Pomodoro, Caffeine). Defaults to Sri Lanka time and Melbourne weather.
name: Second Clock + Weather + Pomodoro
